layouts.name: Horizontal four-button / N30-style — independent X/Y
layouts.notes: Four independent inputs in two horizontal pairs. Map their physical positions, regardless of the Xbox letters the device reports. If the upper buttons repeat A/B rather than reporting separate inputs, choose the N30 turbo variant.

layouts.name: 8BitDo N30-style — A/B plus hardware turbo buttons
layouts.notes: Two lower gameplay buttons plus upper Turbo B/A. Hardware turbo repeats existing inputs, not two extra gameplay controls. Use the independent X/Y variant if your USB mode reports four distinct buttons.

layouts.name: Nintendo Game Boy Advance — A/B + L/R
layouts.notes: Standard GBA controls. Cartridge motion, solar sensors and rumble are separate capabilities, not additional face buttons.

layouts.name: Retro Fighters Brawler64 — N64 controls
layouts.notes: Schematic of common Brawler64 gameplay controls. Extra buttons vary by edition; choose Skip where absent. Calibration, not the marketing name, establishes wiring.

layouts.name: PlayStation — original digital controller
layouts.notes: Digital PlayStation pad: four face buttons, L1/R1/L2/R2, D-pad, Select and Start. No analog sticks or stick clicks. Original schematic, not a measured shell.

layouts.name: PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16 — two-button pad
layouts.notes: Standard two-button gameplay layout. Turbo controls, when present, repeat I/II rather than providing additional game inputs.
